segments.normalizedSource: The time limit applies to each test in the test suite and any child test suites, or each test case for parameterized tests.
segments.contextBefore: When you apply a time limit to a test suite, the testing library recursively applies it to all test functions and child test suites within that suite.
segments.contextAfter: For example, if a suite contains five tests and you apply a time limit trait with a duration of one minute, then each test in the suite may run for up to one minute.

segments.contextBefore: For example, if a suite contains five tests and you apply a time limit trait with a duration of one minute, then each test in the suite may run for up to one minute.
segments.contextAfter: When you apply a time limit to a parameterized test function, the testing library applies it to each invocation *separately* so that if only some cases cause failures due to timeouts, then the testing library doesn’t incorrectly mark successful cases as failing.
segments.documentTitle: Limiting the running time of tests
